en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing an elegant street view with ornate 19th-century European buildings, decorative wrought-iron balconies, shopfronts, and a small park or landscaped area with a fountain. There are a few people strolling along the sidewalk and in the park. The foreground features manicured greenery and flowers. The text on the postcard is printed in red and German, including the names 'Marienbad' and 'Untere Kreuzbrunnenstrasse.' Additional publisher details are included at the bottom.
